editorial.description_en: Water at the end of the day, when it has stopped reflecting and started holding.
editorial.description_ja: 夕方の水のような、深みのある青。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.700, C 0.072, h 250.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 夕 (yū, evening) + 水 (mizu, water). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Evening Water" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 夕水. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — ko-men at ΔE00 6.0, natsu-zora at ΔE00 6.6, kumori-nami at ΔE00 6.9. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (70°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
